recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast 1980s-style composition featuring vibrant, bulbous red title lettering with white highlights above a central neon-tube illustration of stylized characters on a solid black field.
coreVisualRelationships: Large, heavy title text dominates the upper third of the frame.
A rectangular neon-bordered box contains the primary character illustrations.
High contrast between the pitch-black background and the glowing neon elements.
coreInvariants: Neon tube aesthetic for internal illustrations
Glossy, rounded 'bubble' treatment for the main title

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Title is centered at the top; neon illustration box is centered in the lower two-thirds.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright red, thick-stroked title text.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large red title, move down to the glowing neon character outlines, and finally to the small metadata text at the very top.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black negative space surrounds all elements, emphasizing the glow.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant Red (Title and primary neon accents)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Cyan, White, and Pink (Neon tube outlines)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation and high value for the light-emitting elements against a zero-value background.

letterConstructionRules: Letters are thick and bulbous with rounded terminals.
Internal white highlights suggest a 3D, glossy, or plastic surface.
Tight kerning with slight overlap between characters.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'O' in the first word contains a circular cutout showing a photographic eye detail.
Exclamation point is integrated into the flow of the second word.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy custom display type paired with a clean, wide-tracked utility sans-serif for metadata.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the heavy, rounded 70s/80s display feel.
Provides the correct terminal geometry for the base skeleton.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a solid black background. In the lower two-thirds, place a thin rectangular frame made of white neon tubes. Inside the frame, illustrate two stylized cartoon characters using glowing neon tube outlines in red, cyan, and pink. The characters should have a retro 1950s-cartoon aesthetic but rendered in 1980s neon.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, centered, two-line display text in the upper third. The text should be bright red, ultra-bold, and rounded with white glossy highlights. Add a single line of small, white, wide-tracked sans-serif text at the very top edge.

verificationChecks: Do the characters look like glowing neon tubes?
Is the main title text thick and glossy?
Is there a photographic eye detail inside one of the letters?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the neon tubes have a visible 'core' and 'glow'.
Check that the title highlights follow the curvature of the letters.
Verify the metadata text is legible but unobtrusive.
Confirm the black background is uniform and deep.
recipe.reuseFormula: Solid black field + Glowing neon character box + Glossy bulbous display type = Retro Soundtrack Aesthetic.
